# it does not reproduce. Ratcheting works as in juice-12.txt.
preserve-important/cascade/inline-important-wins  juice 9 keeps the author's `!important` text instead of normalising it to ` !important`
*/inline-seed/important-spellings  juice 9 recognises only the exact `!important` spelling and keeps other spellings in the value
*/inline-seed/quotes  ALLOW: same divergence as juice 12 (CssSyntaxError on an encoded quote in a style attribute)
*/malformed/stray-closing-bracket  juice 9's CSS parser (mensch) recovers from malformed CSS differently
*/nesting/stray-paren  juice 9 does not support CSS nesting: it throws or misreads nested rules, while this package flattens them as juice 12 does
